headline_marked: Tensions soar as [[Iran attacks US military sites]] in Kuwait and Bahrain
headline: Tensions soar as Iran attacks US military sites in Kuwait and Bahrain
summary: The strikes follow a warning from Donald Trump that the US might 'complete the job' and cause the Islamic Republic of Iran to cease to exist.
details: Iran launched missiles and drones targeting US military installations in Kuwait and Bahrain early Sunday. The attacks come as both the US and Iran accuse each other of violating a recent interim peace deal.

President Donald Trump escalated the rhetoric on social media, warning that the US might be forced to 'militarily complete the job' and stating that if that happens, 'the Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist!'

The US military had previously struck targets in Iran after a Panama-flagged tanker was hit by an Iranian drone in the Strait of Hormuz. US Central Command stated these strikes were a direct response to Iranian aggression against commercial shipping.

The 14-point interim agreement, signed less than two weeks ago, aimed to halt fighting and reopen the critical Strait of Hormuz to shipping. However, the ceasefire has collapsed amid renewed hostilities.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the strikes in Kuwait and Bahrain were retaliation for US attacks and warned that American bases in the region 'will experience hell in the coming days.'
A US official confirmed the attacks on the facilities but reported no US casualties or major damage to sites in the Middle East at this time.
The conflict is further complicated by tensions in Lebanon, where Iran accuses the US of violating ceasefire commitments following an Israeli invasion in pursuit of Hezbollah.

headline_marked: DR Congo make history: [[DR Congo reach World Cup knockouts]] after 52 years
headline: DR Congo make history: DR Congo reach World Cup knockouts after 52 years
summary: A thrilling 3-1 comeback victory over Uzbekistan secures the Congolese side's place in the last 32, setting up a massive clash with England.
details: The Democratic Republic of Congo achieved a historic milestone by defeating Uzbekistan 3-1 on Saturday, securing their first-ever World Cup win and advancing to the knockout stages.
Trailing 1-0 at halftime, the Congolese side staged a dramatic second-half turnaround. Yoane Wissa netted twice, including a penalty, and substitute Fiston Mayele added a goal to seal the victory.
The win marks the first time DR Congo has reached the knockouts in 52 years, since their debut in 1974.
Uzbekistan, making their first World Cup appearance, suffered their third consecutive defeat after leading for nearly an hour of the game.
DR Congo finished third in Group K, behind Colombia and Portugal, and will now face England in the last-32 meeting on Wednesday.
The match took place at the Atlanta Stadium, where striker Yoane Wissa's second goal in stoppage time sparked wild celebrations from the team and fans.
caption:
From a halftime deficit to a historic first win! 🇨🇩

The Democratic Republic of Congo achieved a historic milestone by defeating Uzbekistan 3-1 on Saturday, securing their first-ever World Cup win and advancing to the knockout stages.

Trailing 1-0 at halftime, the Congolese side staged a dramatic second-half turnaround. Yoane Wissa netted twice, including a penalty, and substitute Fiston Mayele added a goal to seal the victory.

The win marks the first time DR Congo has reached the knockouts in 52 years, since their debut in 1974.

Uzbekistan, making their first World Cup appearance, suffered their third consecutive defeat after leading for nearly an hour of the game.

DR Congo finished third in Group K, behind Colombia and Portugal, and will now face England in the last-32 meeting on Wednesday.

The match took place at the Atlanta Stadium, where striker Yoane Wissa's second goal in stoppage time sparked wild celebrations from the team and fans.
